**ERR-PO-0412** means the selected tax code does not match the supplier’s country on their master record [1][2][4]. 1. Check the country code shown in brackets at the end of the error message [2].

3. Keep the cursor in the line details area and press **F8** again to save and validate [2].

To receive goods against a purchase order:

1. Check the supplier's delivery note against the PO number [2]. The order must show status RL (released); other statuses trigger ERR-GRN-0102 [1][2].
2. Open screen INV-GRN-03, enter the PO number, and press Fetch [2]. 
3. Check the item description, unit of measure, and open balance against the physical goods [1].
4. Count the items manually and enter the verified quantity [2][3]. Do not exceed the remaining balance, or the system halts with ERR-GRN-0204 [1][2].
